riverLeash.title: Moving water needs a different leash
riverLeash.body: On flat water an ankle leash is the right choice — the board is your flotation device and the wind cannot take it away. In moving water, however, an ankle leash can snag on a submerged obstacle (tree trunk, branch, bridge pier) and the current can hold you under. On rivers use a quick-release waist leash that you can release in one move, even under load.
riverLeash.pfd: A buoyancy aid or life jacket is especially warranted on moving water — reaching the bank in a current is far harder than on a lake.
